parts.name: Wheel
parts.Basic_description: This is the wheel of the cart, made of steel, typically circular and attached to the axle for movement.
parts.Functional_description: The wheel allows the cart to roll smoothly and supports the load during transportation.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around the axle to enable forward and backward motion of the cart.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base body of the cart, made of wood, forming the main structure that holds the load.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the main platform for carrying goods and connects to the handles and wheel assembly.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary relative to the wheel, providing structural support and stability.
